kitchen.note: The kitchen mini PC: mic, speakers and NFC in one box. No rooms key, so its replies stay on its own speaker. music_player is the squeezelite jukebox the NFC reader also drives. Deliberately no music_volume: the kitchen's levels are their own domain (jukebox knob, announcements, New Mode) and voice music must not override them.

master.note: Mic-only Pi in the master closet. The wake ding stays on its little USB speaker; spoken replies and timer alarms go out the master bath speakers. alarm_volume is well above the reply volume of 20 on purpose - a reply is for someone standing there, an alarm has to carry over a running shower. Music starts at 20 and cannot be talked above 40 (the alarm is 45, and nobody should be able to walk a speaker into alarm territory with kids under it). music_cap_minutes stops it by itself: the people it plays for are in the tub, two rooms from the nearest microphone.

simon.note: Voice PE in Simon's room. The device owns only mic, LED and chimes; replies, timer alarms and music use the Simon amp-zone speakers. Child-safe ceilings and a one-hour music cap are intentional.
